skill_id.description: Stable skill identifier matching the folder name under agents/skills/.

verifier_pubkey.description: Base58 Solana public key for the verifier or authority that signed the attestation.

proof_hash.description: Digest of the audited skill artifact bundle or formal proof package.

verification_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for the verification event.

is_formally_verified.description: True only when the skill has passed the OpenClawd verification workflow and has an issued attestation.
